# apple_user (Resource)

Invites a person to the App Store Connect team and manages their roles once they accept. The resource is an invitation (`status = "INVITED"`) until the person accepts it, and then the user (`status = "ACTIVE"`). An invitation expires 3 days after it is sent; the next apply after that sends a new one. A person who is already a user or has a pending invitation is adopted.

Grant access to specific apps with `apple_user_visible_app` once the invitation is accepted. Destroying this resource cancels the invitation or removes the user from the team. Import it by email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Invite a developer with access limited to the apps granted below.
resource "apple_user" "dev" {
  email            = "dev@example.com"
  first_name       = "Dev"
  last_name        = "Eloper"
  roles            = ["DEVELOPER"]
  all_apps_visible = false
}

resource "apple_user" "finance" {
  email      = "finance@example.com"
  first_name = "Fin"
  last_name  = "Ance"
  roles      = ["FINANCE"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the person. Changing it invites someone else.
- `first_name` (String) First name, sent with the invitation. Users manage their own names, so changing it later changes nothing in App Store Connect.
- `last_name` (String) Last name, sent with the invitation, like `first_name`.
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles of the user: `ADMIN`, `FINANCE`, `SALES`, `MARKETING`, `APP_MANAGER`, `DEVELOPER`, `ACCESS_TO_REPORTS`, `CUSTOMER_SUPPORT`, `CREATE_APPS`, `CLOUD_MANAGED_DEVELOPER_ID`, `CLOUD_MANAGED_APP_DISTRIBUTION`, `GENERATE_INDIVIDUAL_KEYS`. Changes are made in place; a pending invitation is sent again with the new roles.

### Optional

- `all_apps_visible` (Boolean) Whether the user can see every app. Admin, Finance and Access to Reports users always can. Set it to `false` to limit access to the apps granted with `apple_user_visible_app`.
- `provisioning_allowed` (Boolean) Whether the user can access Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles.

### Read-Only

- `invitation_expiration_date` (String) When the pending invitation expires, in RFC 3339 format.
- `invitation_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the pending invitation.
- `status` (String) `INVITED` until the invitation is accepted, then `ACTIVE`.
- `user_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the user, once the invitation is accepted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_user.dev
  identity = {
    email = "dev@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the user.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_user.dev dev@example.com
```
